title: Currency + decimal is a decimal number

source.quote: if an addition operation uses a real number in combination with currency data, DAX converts both values to REAL and returns the result as REAL
source.supports: the Addition (+) table of result types: INTEGER+INTEGER is INTEGER, INTEGER+REAL is REAL, CURRENCY+INTEGER is CURRENCY, CURRENCY+REAL is REAL

source.quote: When a decimal is involved, the result is decimal. Otherwise, when a currency is involved then the result is currency. The result is integer only when both operands are also integers.
Returns the value as a currency data type
source.supports: CURRENCY ( x ) is a currency (fixed decimal) value

derivation: CURRENCY ( 1.5 ) is a currency and 0.25 a decimal number. CURRENCY + REAL is REAL: 1.5 + 0.25 = 1.75.
